description: This file contains declarations of filesystem utility functions and classes used for path manipulation, file operations, and build directory management within a build system, specifically for GN (Generate Ninja) build tool.

classes.name: BuildDirContext
classes.description: A class encapsulating information about the build directory context, including toolchain details and source/build directory types.

methods.name: FilePathToUTF8
methods.description: Converts a FilePath object to a UTF-8 encoded string.

methods.name: UTF8ToFilePath
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to a FilePath object.

methods.name: FindExtensionOffset
methods.description: Finds the position of the file extension in a path string.

methods.name: FindExtension
methods.description: Returns a view of the file extension in a path string.

methods.name: FindFilenameOffset
methods.description: Finds the position of the filename in a path string.

methods.name: FindFilename
methods.description: Returns a view of the filename including extension.

methods.name: FindFilenameNoExtension
methods.description: Returns a view of the filename without extension.

methods.name: RemoveFilename
methods.description: Removes the filename component from a path string.

methods.name: IsSlash
methods.description: Checks if a character is a slash or backslash.

methods.name: EndsWithSlash
methods.description: Checks if a path string ends with a slash.

methods.name: FindDir
methods.description: Returns the directory part of a path.

methods.name: FindLastDirComponent
methods.description: Returns the last component of a directory path.

methods.name: IsStringInOutputDir
methods.description: Checks if a string is within a specified output directory.

methods.name: EnsureStringIsInOutputDir
methods.description: Verifies if a string references a file inside a given output directory.

methods.name: IsPathAbsolute
methods.description: Checks if a path is absolute.

methods.name: IsPathSourceAbsolute
methods.description: Checks if a path is source-absolute.

methods.name: MakeAbsolutePathRelativeIfPossible
methods.description: Makes an absolute path relative to a source root if possible.

methods.name: MakeAbsoluteFilePathRelativeIfPossible
methods.description: Makes an absolute file path relative to a base path if possible.

methods.name: NormalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes a path, resolving '.', '..', and slashes.

methods.name: ConvertPathToSystem
methods.description: Converts slashes in a path to system-specific separators.

methods.name: RebasePath
methods.description: Makes a path relative to a destination directory.

methods.name: ResolveRelative
methods.description: Resolves a relative or system-absolute path based on a value and source root.

methods.name: ResolvePath
methods.description: Resolves a file or directory path relative to a source root.

methods.name: DirectoryWithNoLastSlash
methods.description: Returns a directory path with no trailing slash.

methods.name: SourceDirForPath
methods.description: Returns a SourceDir object for a given path, relative to source root.

methods.name: SourceDirForCurrentDirectory
methods.description: Returns a SourceDir for the current directory.

methods.name: GetOutputSubdirName
methods.description: Returns the subdirectory name for a given toolchain label.

methods.name: ContentsEqual
methods.description: Checks if a file's contents match a given string.

methods.name: WriteFile
methods.description: Writes data to a file, returning success status.
